answer: Last month an operator ran 200 accounts off one container image and every one answered inside the same minute; the fingerprint caught it because all 200 hashed to one model file and one host salt. Cause and effect: identical fingerprints get one payout, one audit, and a slash of the bond behind the whole jetty. A whisper of suspicion becomes a public signal instead of a private note, and the next copy pays before it earns.
